title: Tech Note: Deep linking with 4D for iOS: implementation and deployment
author: Chaima ELBHIOUI, Technical Support Engineer, 4D Morocco

historical_commentary.text: 4D for iOS, the native mobile-app-generation product this entire note is built on, has since been discontinued by 4D, making this deep-linking guidance obsolete along with the whole product line it depended on.
related_updates: 4D for iOS (and the related 4D for Android generation) was discontinued as 4D shifted its mobile strategy toward Qodly, a separate low-code platform, and toward responsive ORDA/REST-based web apps accessible from mobile browsers

Developers needing deep-linking-like behavior today would implement it at the web-app/PWA level (universal-link-style routing in a responsive ORDA/REST web front end) rather than through the retired native app generator described here
